test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: What sum of money (in Rs.) will earn an interest of Rs. 1,800 at the rate of 6% per annum simple interest in five years?
solution:
**Given:**

Interest (I) = Rs. 1,800

Rate (R) = 6% per annum

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (I) = (Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T)) / 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ 1800 = (P × 6 × 5) / 100

⇒ 1800 = (30P) / 100

⇒ 1800 × 100 = 30P

⇒ P = (1800 × 100) / 30

⇒ P = 180000 / 30

⇒ P = 6000

**The sum of money (in Rs.) is 6000.**
